title: Architect Time and the Remobilization Fee — Professional Services Projects
content:
Solutions architect time logged on a Professional Services Projects engagement adds an architect re-ramp amount to the remobilization fee of a fixed-fee engagement resumed after a long client-caused hold.

750.00 is added to the remobilization fee when architect time logged on the engagement totals 2400 minutes or more, 350.00 when some but less architect time is logged, and nothing when none is.

| Architect time logged on the engagement | Added |
|---|---|
| 2400 minutes (40 hours) or more | 750.00 |
| more than zero, less than 2400 minutes | 350.00 |
| none | nothing |

All architect time logged on the engagement counts, in any time band and on any date. Hypothetical boundary cases: 2399 minutes adds 350.00 and 2400 minutes adds 750.00.
